title: Full-generator Kubo-Mori pairing cancellation for actual finite Q3 D and delta-D
question: For the actual finite Q3 history D(t), can the full generator pairing identity <delta^2 D,D>_KM + <delta D,delta D>_KM = 0 provide a genuine cancellation-aware replacement for isolating the divergent V'f' term?

model.graph: two-site edge and four-site square face
model.cutoff: replace only bond coordinates by the smooth cosine cutoff q_L; W_L=H-H_L
model.history: D_sigma(t)=U_(H+sigma W_L)(t) A_2 U_(H+sigma W_L)(t)^* - U_H(t) A_2 U_H(t)^*
model.kubo_mori_inner_product: <A,B>_KM=2 sum_ij L(p_i,p_j) conjugate(A_ij) B_ij in the H Gibbs eigenbasis
model.interpretation: the force and kinetic pieces are retained in delta_H^2 as a full-generator pairing; no standalone V'f' multiplier is claimed

adversarial_review.check: The i[H,·]/hbar convention is used consistently in delta and delta-squared, and the Kubo-Mori skew-adjoint identity is checked in both orientations.
No termwise cancellation of V'f' is asserted; only the complete finite generator delta_H^2 is paired with D, so kinetic and potential contributions remain together.
The logarithmic-mean diagonal limit is used at equal probabilities and each beta row is recomputed from the actual H spectrum.
D and delta-D are generated from the exact finite H and H+sigma W_L histories; no proxy h' is substituted.
Volumes two and four are finite diagnostics only; any observed ratio is reported without asymptotic monotonicity or a no-go claim.
Uniform direct D/delta-D Cauchy, modular domain, product/core density, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks the exact rational spectral coefficients and cancellation identity; matrix diagonalization, Kubo-Mori integrals, operator domains, and thermodynamic/QFT limits remain in Python and are finite-only.

qft_interface.closed: An actual finite Q3 two-orientation D/delta-D history audit and a full-generator Kubo-Mori cancellation identity for each finite H eigenbasis.
qft_interface.open: A source/volume/beta-uniform direct-Cauchy theorem, modular domain transfer, product/core density, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: This replaces only the invalid termwise-force estimate by a finite full-generator pairing. It is not a common infinite-volume dynamics theorem.

no_overclaim: The finite identity demonstrates a valid cancellation-aware pairing for actual D and delta-D, but does not supply a uniform bound or close any QFT, Sector A, or Pre-A gate.
